implementation_notes: The AI Pact is a voluntary initiative preparatory to the binding EU AI Act. Pillar I is a knowledge-sharing community open to all stakeholders. Pillar II involves voluntary pledges by providers and deployers. More than 230 companies have signed pledges. Reporting on progress is invited but not legally mandated.
